meta.name: hivemind-graph
meta.description: Query the local AST-derived code graph (functions, classes, calls, imports) for structural codebase questions — what calls X, what does Y import, where is Z defined, blast radius of a change. The graph rebuilds automatically after each agent turn; use hivemind_graph_search and hivemind_graph_neighborhood tools (no manual build step).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 查询代码结构，分析调用关系与变更影响范围
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在大型代码库中快速理解函数调用链和变更影响
copy.tagline_en: Query code structure, analyze call relationships and change impact
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand function call chains and change impact in a large codebase

howto.what: 装了这个技能后，Claude 能回答关于代码结构的问题，比如谁调用了某个函数、某个文件导入了什么、某个符号在哪里定义。代码图每次对话后自动更新，你不需要手动生成。
howto.when: 当你问关于代码结构或关系的问题时，比如“哪个函数调用了 X？”或“这个文件导入了什么？”。

say.text: 谁调用了 pushSnapshot 函数？
say.note: Claude 会返回调用该函数的符号和位置。
Claude 会列出该文件的所有导入。
Claude 会返回定义的文件和行号。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can answer structural codebase questions: what calls a function, what a file imports, where a symbol is defined. The code graph rebuilds automatically after each turn.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask structural/relational questions about the code, e.g., 'What calls X?' or 'What does Y import?'

say_en.note: Claude lists all imports in that file.
Claude returns the file and line number.
